description: Turns the backup option of a server on or off, or changes its hour (hourLocal 0-23, Eastern time) and retention (1-7 daily backups). Turning it ON costs 14.99 $/month, kept as long as the option stays on; it also makes the move to another GPU possible (gpucloud_migrate_server) (hourly servers: pro rata per billed hour; prepaid: the rest of the paid period now from credits, then with each renewal). Turning it OFF deletes the server's backups (needs canDelete when backups exist; no refund of the current period). On/off take two steps (confirmationToken); hour / retention changes apply directly. [SPENDS MONEY] (permission: servers:backup) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]

confirmationToken.description: Token returned by the previous call without token, valid 10 minutes, single use.
